title: Cross moment of the normalized pair sum
statement: Let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$ and let $n$ be a positive integer. Choose a pair of sign vectors by taking the first uniformly at random and, independently at each coordinate, keeping its sign for the second with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise. The expected product of the two coordinates of their normalized sum (each coordinate sum divided by $\sqrt n$) is $\rho$.
